F_FOYER_WALL.fact: The square-panel wall behind the people is the wall in the foyer-material reference; the floor, clothing and umbrella are separate surfaces.

grounding.description: large pale square-panel wall behind the people in the foyer reference

F_DISPLAY_BOARD.fact: The heavily worn yellow board just right of the pale traction-pad board was the one in our display check; all other boards are separate stock, not my personal surfboards.

grounding.description: full worn yellow board immediately right of the pale board with black traction pads

F_FINISHED_BROCHURES.fact: The front multicoloured brochure pile was the reading I had finished; the separate smaller pile on the near tabletop was still unread. The framed photograph and the remote controls were not in either pile.

grounding.description: whole multicoloured brochure pile at the front of the side table beneath the handheld remote

F_READING_TABLE.fact: The table supporting those brochures and the lamp is the side table in that room reference; neither the lamp nor the crocheted mat is part of its wood surface.

grounding.description: small dark wooden table supporting the lamp and brochures

F_TEA_CUP_SET.fact: The front cup, its own saucer and the loose lid at lower left form the set in the tea-display reference I selected; two rear cups are different display pieces.

grounding.description: complete foreground green cup with its white-rimmed saucer and loose green lid at lower left

F_TEA_SURFACE.fact: The white marble surface beneath the foreground and rear cups is the surface in that tea-display reference, not a personally owned kitchen table.

grounding.description: white marble surface below the displayed tea sets

F_MENU_PLATE_PRINT.fact: The cyan characters on the main square clam plate were the restaurant lettering we left out of the menu draft; the lettering on the adjacent prawn plates belongs to different plates.

grounding.description: cyan restaurant characters printed around the main square clam-plate rim

F_MENU_CLAMS.fact: The large square plate of clams is the dish in that menu draft; the adjacent prawns and the small dish of plain clams are different dishes.

grounding.description: opened clams with chopped vegetables on the original large square plate

F_FRONTAGE_TABLE.fact: The leftmost high round table just left of the open doorway is the table from our frontage check; other high tables and the freestanding chalkboard are different fixtures.

grounding.description: leftmost narrow round high table immediately left of the open shop doorway

F_FRONTAGE_FASCIA.fact: The wide brown FERMENT signboard above the awning is the fascia in that same frontage check; the white awning and the neighbouring black storefront are separate.

grounding.description: wide brown signboard above the white awning carrying FERMENT

F_RIVER_REFERENCE.fact: The visible water between and below the piers is the river in the bridge reference I saved; the train and vegetation are separate parts of the scene.

grounding.description: visible river under the railway bridge between the piers

F_CLEANUP_LITTER.fact: The cleanup note recorded the hard suitcase, white carrier bag, blue food packet and small spiral notebook as what we had already collected. The visible clear bottles, disposable cup and loose clear/white plastic fragments remained for the next pass. Natural grass, roots, fallen leaves and branches were never in the collection list; none of the litter is a user-owned keepsake.
